defs.meaning: 把……载入正式记录；行驶，行进；采伐（森林的）树木（log 的现在分词）

examples.en: The Bolivian government has granted logging concessions covering 22 million hectares.
examples.zh: 玻利维亚政府批准了在2 200万公顷土地上的伐木特许权。

examples.en: Logging companies would have to leave a central area of the forest before the end of the year.
examples.zh: 伐木公司可能得于年底前在森林中留出一个中心地带。

examples.en: If all else fails, keep calm and try logging on again!
examples.zh: 如果所有办法都失败了，保持镇静并再次尝试登录！
